author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX conducts an additional preflight test of Booster 20 at Pad 2 ahead of Starship Flight 13. This test is in relation to engine swaps following the T-0 abort during the first launch attempt. Should all go well, the second launch attempt will take place on Thursday.

title: SpaceX conducts preflight Booster 20 test

author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX continues to target Thursday, pending successful testing of Booster 20 on Pad 2 on Wednesday. The booster has received engine swapouts following last week's T-0 abort, with removed engines spotted at the McGregor test site.
